patterns: NCR composition is the most repeated item: 'which state is NOT in NCR' (Punjab, MP) and 'which town is in NCR' (Ambala trap).
Term-coiner one-liners: Megalopolis = Jean Gottmann; APPSC 2018 asked 'world's largest city' (Tokyo - now superseded by WUP 2025 Jakarta, so keys date).
APPSC adds disaster-management angles (flood mitigation: basements are not a remedy) and slum-related current affairs (Dharavi).

App's Census 2011 slum facts with AP tilt (undivided AP highest share, Greater Visakhapatnam highest city share) suit APPSC well; Economic-Survey and Swachh-category items are more current-affairs heavy than PYQs.
